entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I hope you can help. I bought a jersey a little while ago, and I need to return it. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. I saved up for it, you know? And when I finally tried it on... it was just the wrong size. It's way too tight across the chest.

I understand, that's definitely frustrating when something doesn't fit as expected. Let me pull up that order... VF88602. Okay, I see the Pro-Cycle jersey, delivered on December 3rd. That was about 36 days ago.

Oh no, has it been that long? I've been so busy, I completely lost track. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years... I was really hoping I hadn't missed my chance. I really needed this money back if I can't wear it.
No need to worry at all. I've just checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day window for a return. We can definitely get this sorted out for you.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief! So I can get a refund? Or maybe an exchange for a larger size?
Absolutely. We can process a full refund to your original payment method, or I can set up an exchange for the correct size if you'd prefer. The choice is yours.
You know what, a refund would be wonderful. Thank you so much, Isaac. You've really turned my day around.

I'm happy to help. I have initiated the return for you. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive the jersey, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's perfect. Thank you again for being so helpful.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
